summary: A production alert was triaged automatically by Vigil, briefed to on-call, and resolved. Details are captured in the timeline and analysis below.

timeline.event: Alert fired and was ingested by Vigil.
Triage brief posted to the on-call channel.

root_cause: Root cause undetermined from the automated analysis; the leading hypotheses from the retrieved evidence are recorded in the incident's commit-candidate rationales and runbook citation.
contributing_factors: See commit-candidate analysis in the incident record.
impact: See the deterministic impact figures recorded on the incident (severity, estimated affected requests, duration).
resolution: Resolved by on-call action; see the resolution source recorded on the incident.
went_well: Automated brief delivered the alert context, candidate commits, and runbook in one place.
went_poorly: Automated analysis could not pinpoint a root cause with high confidence.

action_items.description: Review the incident record and confirm or correct the root-cause hypothesis.
Update the relevant runbook with what actually fixed the issue.
